<!-- One to three full sentences on what changes and why; the commit message can be the same. -->

- [ ] every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) — the `dco` check enforces it
- [ ] `pytest` and `ruff` green; new functions come with tests
- [ ] goldens changed only on purpose — if so, say why below
- [ ] a decision behind this change has its ADR under `docs/adr/` and a row in the index
- [ ] the docs moved with the code (`docs/commands/`, concept page, README)
